strings.name: Prabowo Subianto
strings.summary: Prabowo grew up in a political family, spending part of his childhood abroad. A 1974 military academy graduate, he later commanded special forces. The military dismissed him over responsibility connected to the 1998 abduction of activists; he denies human-rights abuse allegations. He entered business and party politics, lost two presidential races, served as defence minister and became president in 2024.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Moved from the military and defence affairs into Indonesia’s presidency; his security, development and international relations policies have regional influence.

strings.highlights.h1.title: From army to presidency
strings.highlights.h1.text: Party building, elections and defence service preceded his 2024 inauguration.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Controversy and accountability
strings.highlights.h2.text: The 1998 abductions and rights allegations remain part of his political record.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Inaugurated president
strings.timeline.t1.text: Became Indonesia’s eighth president, with Gibran as vice president.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Defence minister
strings.timeline.t2.text: Joined Joko Widodo’s cabinet after losing the presidential election.
strings.timeline.t3.title: First presidential bid
strings.timeline.t3.text: Lost to Joko Widodo and subsequently ran again.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Helped establish Gerindra
strings.timeline.t4.text: Moved from military and business activities into party building.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Military dismissal
strings.timeline.t5.text: Dismissed over responsibility connected to the abduction of democracy activists.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Special forces commander
strings.timeline.t6.text: Led Kopassus; associated operations later drew rights scrutiny.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Military academy graduate
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed academy training and began his officer career.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Jakarta
strings.timeline.t8.text: Son of economist Sumitro; spent part of childhood abroad.
